description: This file defines a Tooltip utility for React Native, including a Tooltips class with methods to show and dismiss tooltips, constants for positions, and a show function for triggering tooltips with specific options.

classes.name: Tooltips
classes.description: A class providing static methods to show and dismiss tooltips with configurable options.

methods.name: Tooltips.Show
methods.description: Displays a tooltip with specified target, parent, and options.

methods.name: Tooltips.Dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the tooltip associated with the specified target.

methods.name: show
methods.description: A helper function to show a tooltip on an event target with specified text and position.
